verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an AI agent on its root-cause-analysis docs page that takes a production error and produces a reviewable pull request. That covers the core of the story: AI analysis leading to something actionable. The evidence is a single thin doc mention and does not describe which signals the agent uses. missing for 10: documentation that the analysis uses stack traces, breadcrumbs/telemetry and related commits or deploys, an explicit written root-cause explanation (beyond a PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
